main_text.p: rum redolent sapientiæ: At quales obsecro ab historijs hisce mores, vel à Catechumenis(ad quos relegabat istos Athanasius) edisci, imbibiquepossunt? Verè ego de istis dixerim,quod Chius ille seruus, de Domino suo vinum vendente alijs, epotante vappam; Cum adsunt bona, quærunt mala: Sint verò hi (quantumuis olim fatente Epiphanio, Epiph.l.1.sec.5.ἐν ἀμφιλεκτῳ) sacri omnes, sint (quod voluit Carthaginensis Synodus, totiesq; prouocatus istic Augustinus) ἀνυπερ-ἡγιοντικοί: Diuini tamen vt sint, quis hominum vel Angelorum præstare vnquam poterit? Nouimus

page.notes: Margin note at left reads "Epiph.l.1.sec.5." (marginal reference). Greek phrases in the text are only approximately reproduced; the Greek word after "Augustinus)" is doubtful, and the Greek in the first parenthesis is doubtful. Faded marginal text at the left edge is not legible and is omitted.
